preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string must be exactly 7 characters long.
The input string must start with a '#'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789ABCDEFabcdef' for c in hex_string[1:])
preconditions.description: The remaining characters in the input string must be valid hexadecimal digits.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a dictionary.
The dictionary must contain the keys 'r', 'g', and 'b'.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, int) for value in return_value.values())
postconditions.description: The values associated with the keys 'r', 'g', and 'b' must be integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= value <= 255 for value in return_value.values())
postconditions.description: The values associated with the keys 'r', 'g', and 'b' must be within the range 0 to 255.
The value of 'r' must be the decimal equivalent of the first two hexadecimal digits.
The value of 'g' must be the decimal equivalent of the next two hexadecimal digits.
The value of 'b' must be the decimal equivalent of the last two hexadecimal digits.
